messages.content: joey just spent twenty minutes staring at the bird feeder out the window
Operational profile in full effect. The window is the channel; the birds are the content. He's not bored, he's tuned in.
joey knocked a pen off my desk again. just walked up and pushed it off the edge
Gravity-test protocol. He's confirming the laws of physics still apply. The pen had it coming.
joey's getting older. didn't jump up on the bed last night, just sat next to it waiting

Senior-cat signal — back legs or arthritis, usually. Worth bringing up at the next vet visit if it keeps showing up; a small step or ramp by the bed is the immediate fix so he's not asking for the lift every night.
joey laid down right on top of the laundry pile I just folded
Warm, clean, smells like you. Three of the four boxes checked. The laundry was always going to lose.
